body: That field isn't wired up at all.... :facepalm:
OK - the field *is* wired up when we reduce many buckets together but if there is just a single shard's worth or results I don't believe we set it. And we might destroy it in other ways too!
So I should keep my mouth shut - it looks like this thing is only used as part of reductions. I'll figure this out!
OK! I found it and will open a PR soon.

issue.title: Fix auto_date_histogram interval

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
`auto_date_histogram` was returning the incorrect `interval` because
of a combination of two things:
1. When pipeline aggregations rewrote `auto_date_histogram` we reset the
   interval to 1. Oops. Fixed that.
2. *Every* bucket aggregation was rewriting its buckets as though there
   was a pipeline aggregation even if there aren't any. This is a bit
   silly so we skip that too.

Closes #56116
